title: Pasar a: Moving On to the Next Step
goal: Use pasar a + infinitive to move on to the next step.

items: I can use *pasar a* + infinitive to move on to the next step of a talk, a task or a career.
I can tell *pasar a* from *empezar a*.
I can use the new words for stages and sequences.
